headline: World Gym Q3 Net Profit Surges 56% to NT$177 Million as Locations Pass 300
summary: World Gym Corporation reported Q3 2026 net profit of NT$177 million ($5.61 million), up 56% year-over-year, with EPS reaching NT$1.62. The board approved a Q3 dividend of NT$1.455 per share as total global operational locations crossed 300.
why: World Gym Corporation (2762.TW) operates fitness centers across Asia, serving as an indicator for regional consumer health and discretionary spending.

impacts.name: World Gym Taiwan
impacts.why: Company reported a 56% annual jump in Q3 net profit and declared quarterly dividends.
